meta.description: A free self-assessment about six areas of your daily life. About 15 minutes, no account needed.
welcome.title: Your Equilibrar Map
welcome.p1: You've probably been told to eat better, sleep more and stress less. You already know that. What nobody has shown you is how the pieces of your life connect — and why nothing held before.
welcome.p2: In about 15 minutes, this Map looks at six areas of your everyday life — Space, Routine, Sleep, Calm, Food and Strength — and shows you where you have the least support right now, and where we would begin.
welcome.p3: There are no right or wrong answers. Answer for how your life really is, not how you think it should be. You'll see your full Map the moment you finish — free, nothing hidden.
welcome.p4: I'm Rê — nutritionist and physical educator. I built Equilibrar for the woman I kept meeting in clinics and gyms: doing everything right, and still not feeling well. Every woman I work with starts right here.
welcome.time: About 15 minutes · free · no account needed

phrase.space: there's no room in your week for you
phrase.routine: your days have no rhythm to hold new habits
phrase.sleep: your body never gets the chance to recover
phrase.strength: your body isn't getting the movement it needs
work.space.looksLike: Everyone relies on you, and you come last on your own list
work.space.weDo: This is where the method starts: saying no without guilt, asking for help, putting yourself back on the list
work.space.towards: Time that is really yours, and less guilt in taking it
work.routine.looksLike: Every day is different; meals happen when they happen
work.routine.weDo: A week that works for you, a kitchen set up for easy good food, small habits that survive busy days, the Balance Diary
work.routine.towards: Fewer decisions, more days that go to plan
work.sleep.looksLike: Late nights to get time for yourself, waking up already tired
work.sleep.weDo: Working with your daily rhythm, an evening routine, how to regulate your sleep
work.sleep.towards: Waking with more energy, and steadier days
work.calm.looksLike: Always on, and hard on yourself
work.calm.weDo: Slow breathing and the three-minute pause, and understanding stress and emotions
work.calm.towards: Coming back to calm faster, so stress no longer decides your day
work.food.looksLike: Eating in a hurry, afternoon cravings, cycles of rules and guilt
work.food.weDo: Nourishment without dieting: meals that satisfy you, eating enough, planning without rigid rules
work.food.towards: More energy, and peace at the table
work.strength.looksLike: You know you should move, but there's no time or energy left
work.strength.weDo: A strength base at home, strength after 40, mobility for a sitting day — built on the room made first
work.strength.towards: A body that keeps up with your life

practice.routine: Have breakfast at the same time every day this week

practice.strength: Two 10-minute sessions at home: chair squats, wall push-ups, a short walk

privacy.p1Local: In this version of the Map, nothing you answer leaves your device.
privacy.p1Saving: While you answer, an anonymous Map is saved in Rê's database: your answers as codes and the six pillar scores. Your name, anything you write in your own words, your 24 individual answers and the check-in stay on your device.
privacy.p6Share: If you choose to share your Map with Rê, then your name, your email, whatever you fill in on the form and your 24 answers do go to her — those answers are what she talks you through the first time. Your own words go only if you tick the box that allows it. The check-in never goes, under any circumstances.
privacy.p7Keep: A Map that was never finished is deleted after 30 days of no activity. A finished Map you did not share is deleted after 12 months. If you shared it with Rê and want to be removed, just ask her.
